description: Header file defining the NetworkManager class, NetworkAccessBehavior enum, and related delegates for managing network status and behavior within the CalculatorApp project.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for managing network status and behavior, providing methods to retrieve current network access behavior and handling network status change events.

methods.name: GetNetworkAccessBehavior
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the current network access behavior.

methods.name: OnNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Private method invoked when network status changes, handling the event.

methods.name: ConvertCostInfoToBehavior
methods.description: Static method converting ConnectionCost information to a NetworkAccessBehavior enum value.
